first_metrics_note: first_valid_product_s and first_plan_s are measured from build_started_at, the start of this build session (reconstructed from session tool timestamps).

coverage.notes: Bounded sample: first 2 product URLs in sitemap order; 6658 product URLs remain outside this run. Not full-site coverage.

currency.evidence: JSON-LD Product.offers.priceCurrency bound to the offer price

limitations: Bounded sample: the first 2 product URLs in sitemap order. It is not full-site coverage; the sitemap is the only denominator.

Category listing is server-rendered for one page only (30 cards); '?page=2' returns the same page and further pages load through a JS component, so the plan discovers products from the public sitemap.
Descriptions are the editorial description plus the specification table. The 'Piezas compatibles' related-parts block and recommendation rails are not product copy and are excluded.
Tax basis is not stated on the product page; rows record NOT_STATED.
Prices come from the public php2js variant payload; the ISO currency comes from JSON-LD offers bound to the same offer value.
No LLM is called at runtime; field rules are deterministic Python.
notes: All numbers are read from crawl stats and output files, not from model assertions.
runtime_llm_calls is 0: extraction is deterministic Python.
